cards.title: Signal Restricts Screenshots Over AI Surveillance
cards.body: Signal is limiting screenshot capabilities in its Android and iOS apps to combat AI surveillance threats. The messaging app views screenshot restrictions as essential to protecting user privacy from emerging AI threats.

cards.title: Nvidia's Mixed Signals: Earnings vs. Leadership Drama
cards.body: Nvidia delivered strong earnings, but executives are publicly calling for Jensen Huang's return amid leadership turmoil. The company presents two contrasting narratives—financial health versus internal instability.

cards.title: Top AI Agents Now Live in Text Messages
cards.body: A new wave of AI agents can operate directly within messaging apps, from general assistants to specialized travel and work agents. These agents make AI accessible without leaving your preferred communication platform.

cards.title: Hollywood Actors License Faces to AI Microdrama
cards.body: An actor has licensed his digital likeness to a microdrama startup, mirroring trends already popular in China. Experts warn this could reshape Hollywood if the practice becomes widespread.

cards.title: Daniel Ek Funds AI Researcher's Fusion Power Startup
cards.body: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is backing Europa Fusion, a startup founded by an AI researcher. The company is developing next-generation fusion energy technology.

cards.title: AI and Human Solve 167-Year-Old Math Problem
cards.body: AI has claimed a solution to the Riemann hypothesis while a human competitor also solved it independently. The parallel breakthroughs are reshaping mathematical research capabilities.

cards.title: Space Data Center Financing Faces Collateral Crisis
cards.body: Lenders are hesitant to finance space-based infrastructure when collateral could be launched into orbit. This financing gap threatens the broader space data center industry.

cards.title: Nvidia Posts Strong Earnings Amid CEO Exit Fallout
cards.body: Nvidia reported healthy growth following Jensen Huang's resignation but announced it will stop selling H200 chips to China. The company faces both operational success and geopolitical constraints.

cards.title: Six AI-Powered Gadgets Upgrade Home Offices
cards.body: New AI gadgets from notetakers to webcams are transforming workspace productivity. These tools integrate AI capabilities to streamline daily work tasks.

cards.title: Apple Developing AI Agent for Mac Operating System
cards.body: Apple is reportedly building AI agents to compete with Meta Muse, Claude, and OpenAI Dots. The agent would automate workflows directly on Mac devices.

cards.title: Anthropic Founders Cash Out $2B in Record IPO
cards.body: Anthropic's seven founders each pocketed $280 million at the $83/share IPO price, raising $105 billion. The offering marks a historic moment for AI company valuations.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Charm Wearable May Cost $300
cards.body: Meta's upcoming Muse Charm AI wearable device is rumored to price around $300. The company confirmed more announcements about the device are forthcoming.

cards.title: Recent Tech Outages Mirror Y2K-Style AI Failures
cards.body: Recent airline, banking, and productivity platform outages may stem from deeper AI-related issues beyond mere coincidence. Cybersecurity experts warn of systemic vulnerabilities emerging from AI agent dependencies.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Scandal and Affair
cards.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following an affair, raising national security concerns for U.S.-China AI competition. The scandal threatens to disrupt semiconductor industry leadership during critical AI infrastructure development.

cards.title: Anthropic IPO Could Deliver $156B to Charity
cards.body: At $95 per share, Anthropic's Public Benefit Foundation, employee donations, and company matching could total $156 billion for charitable causes. The structure exemplifies AI companies' commitment to social impact.

cards.title: Google's Gemini Agent Now Controls Your Mac
cards.body: Google updated Gemini with Mac agent capabilities to organize files, fill forms, and automate workflows. The AI can now execute multistep tasks directly on Apple computers.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Mixes Conversations, Exposes Private Data
cards.body: Meta's Muse AI agent reportedly surfaced messages, career advice, and bank balances that belonged to other users. The critical data mixing incident raises serious privacy concerns for the platform.

cards.title: Everful Raises $48.5M for China Factory Sourcing
cards.body: A former Alibaba executive's Everful platform raised $48.5 million to connect retailers with Chinese factories. The factory-direct model streamlines global supply chain operations.

cards.title: Anthropic Opens at $111, Up 33% From IPO
cards.body: Anthropic's stock jumped to $111 at Nasdaq open, well above the $83 IPO price, raising over $80 billion in new capital. The surge reflects massive investor enthusiasm for the AI lab.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Commits to Pacing AI Development
cards.body: Dario Amodei reiterated Anthropic's commitment to responsible AI pacing at the Nasdaq opening bell. The company will maintain this stance regardless of business or political pressures.

cards.title: AI Capabilities Improve But Judgment Tasks Lag
cards.body: METR's new report finds AI capabilities continue improving exponentially, but models struggle with tasks requiring judgment compared to coding. The updated findings challenge assumptions about AI's across-the-board advancement.

cards.title: AI Startup Creates Artificial Nose Matching Human Smell
cards.body: A New Jersey lab trained human sniffers to catalog every odor on Earth, creating training data for an AI model that can identify smells as accurately as humans. The startup aims to revolutionize odor detection across industries.

cards.title: Google Search Gets AI Chat, Removes Search Button
cards.body: Google rolled out a redesigned search homepage featuring AI chat history integration and notably absent search button. The move reflects the company's pivot toward conversational AI search experiences.

cards.title: Meta Reconsiders Climate Goals Amid AI Data Center Emissions
cards.body: Meta is reconsidering its 2030 net-zero emissions goal as AI data centers drive record energy consumption. The company faces mounting pressure to balance AI expansion with environmental commitments.

cards.title: Researcher Exposes Privacy Threat in AI Supply Chain
cards.body: A researcher planted 2 million canaries into the AI supply chain, surfacing a major privacy disaster. The findings highlight vulnerabilities in how AI systems source and process training data.

cards.title: AI Hype Index Shows AI Integration Everywhere
cards.body: Despite costing billions in lost ad revenue, Google continues deploying AI Overviews across search results. The widespread integration demonstrates AI's omnipresence despite practical and economic challenges.
